answers.goal:
Representation! Access! 

 I just want people of all kinds to finally see themselves represented in the media and on the screen.  At the end of the day, media is a tool and one of its impacts should build empathy. Would love to help with creating paths for overlooked voices, and create fun and memorable campaigns for talents!
answers.drew: I’ve always been obsessed with how entertainment connects people, it’s a reminder of how refreshing humanity can be when it portrays itself. I always spent my downtime watching pop culture, keeping up with what’s entertaining, the commentary, and fan edits, so diving into this world was natural. Having a strong background in  photography, event management, and editing has connected to so many other people. And I realized I wanted to be a part of that impact, of making people feel.
answers.seeking:
I’m looking to connect with open-minded, hyped, and passionate people who are ready to hustle and build something meaningful. As a Filipina-American, I would love to connect with other creatives from my community, but honestly, I'm just trying to expand my circle in every way possible. 

I want to surround myself with storytellers, digital creators, and future industry leaders who care about representation and love pop culture as much as I do!! Whether it’s collaborating on any projects or just bouncing ideas around, I’m looking for people who bring good energy and want to push each other forward!! Love listening to rnb & rap, island, and pop music, and love bringing my digi cam everywhere!
answers.inspiration:
My mom, and myself.
Inspired by my family and ancestors who push me forward, they give me motivation to give back to my community
